question: trim-adds
answer:
The **Fjord Plus** includes everything in the Pure, with these differences:

- A power tailgate with hands-free opening
- Keyless entry
- A 360-degree camera
- 20-inch Fern wheels instead of the Pure’s 19-inch Birch wheels
- The Winter pack as standard: heated steering wheel, heated rear seats and battery preconditioning. The heat pump included in the pack is already standard on the Pure. (voltrieve-fjord-price-list.pdf) 

The Winter pack is **optional on the Pure**, while the tailgate, keyless entry and 360-degree camera are not available on that trim. Both trims have the same light wool-blend interior. (voltrieve-fjord-price-list.pdf)

For a complete **left-front brake replacement** on your Voltrieve Fjord AWD, the service guide calls for the following parts. The AWD uses a 370 mm front disc.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| 1 | Front brake pad set, both sides | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |

 (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

You also need **one 1-litre bottle of DOT 4 LV brake fluid, VP-15168**, to bleed the circuit afterwards.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-parts-service-items.md)

The pad set covers both front wheels: pads are renewed as an axle set, even when the rest of the work is on one side.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

Before work under the car, the guide says to put it in service mode; before lifting the Fjord, turn off automatic suspension levelling.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a complete front-left brake replacement, the service guide calls for the parts below. **Check whether your Lumen is RWD or AWD before ordering**: the front disc is 300 mm on RWD and 320 mm on AWD. (voltrieve-service-guide.md)  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

### Choose the parts for your drive

Order one of each item in the column that matches your car:

| Part | RWD | AWD |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | VP-10020 | VP-10033 |
| Front axle brake pad set | VP-10202 | VP-10215 |
| Front-left caliper | VP-10293 | VP-10306 |
| Front-left caliper carrier | VP-10475 | VP-10488 |

(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

### Also order for either drive

| Quantity | Part | Article number |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | VP-10618 |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | VP-10696 |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | VP-10735 |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre | VP-15168 |

(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

The pad set covers **both front sides**; pads should be renewed as an axle set. The right-side disc and caliper are kept unless they are also worn. The Lumen does not need an electrical pad wear sensor. (voltrieve-service-guide.md)  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)
